exceptions.evidence: No rated easy sources. The two bounded families require trigonometric derivatives and expansion; labeling them easy would change observed classification. This is a package capability bound, not a proof that an easy arc-length problem is impossible. New evidence reopens classification.
Missing key, difficulty and solution; preserved unchanged, does not count as inventory.
Exact banks retained and replayed; not exposed to normal generation. Parameterized profiles and changing diagrams would need additional extraction/validation.

distinctness: Squared coordinate derivatives plus ordered bounds; excludes translations, derivative signs, bank, seed and choice order. Exclude all existing source/canonical/generated task fingerprints, including shown tasks.
shortage_policy: Never count unsupported/evidence-only instances as filled; finite domain exhaustion remains explicit.
